(Chuckles warmly) Well, that’s certainly a creative question! I'm not sure there's a *correct* way, really. It's more about muscle memory and whatever feels most natural to you, isn’t it? It's fascinating how much we rely on automatic processes. 

It actually touches on a really interesting area of psychology - procedural memory. That's the kind of memory that allows us to do things like ride a bike or, apparently, spell words in the dark! It’s memory for skills and habits, and it’s largely unconscious. We don't have to actively *think* about each step, our bodies just *do* it. 

So, while I can't tell you the "right" way to spell strawberry blindly, it's a great example of how our brains are constantly working behind the scenes to make our lives easier.
